headline: Moneybagg Yo handed out turkeys and fresh produce to 200 Memphis families for Thanksgiving
body: Moneybagg Yo handed out turkeys and fresh produce to 200 Memphis families for Thanksgiving The reason is personal. His own health journey inspired the giveaway, so the goal was healthier eating, not just a holiday meal. The Memphis Mayor's Office backed the event.
